verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab explicitly advertises "standalone headless operation, from workstation to data center" [docs-10]. Isaac Sim can be composed and scripted through pip-installable Python packages [docs-12], stepped programmatically via ROS 2 services [docs-4], and integrated into existing testing and validation pipelines [docs-16]. Together these cover the core of headless, automated operation. Missing for 10: explicit CI setup docs or examples (e.g. containers or GPU runners), explicit headless-mode documentation for Isaac Sim itself rather than only Isaac Lab, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
